title: USS Omaha sphere as a heat source going behind the horizon
summary: Mick West tells of USS Omaha sphere as a heat source going behind the horizon, about July 2019 at Off San Diego, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But if you zoom in on the video, I think it actually looks more like it's actually going it's actually a heat source that is expanded.

related.note: Both are about the July 2019 USS Omaha sphere video off San Diego, but this telling explains it as an ordinary heat source dropping behind the horizon, not an anomalous craft.
